tagline: Witness an extraordinary transformation of divine elegance.

phase1.name: Baseline
phase1.prompt: Extremely close-up, shallow depth of field. Two Indian male hands gently lower a dark matte neem-wood cube onto a highly reflective grey marble ledge, then fully withdraw. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed textures on wood, metal, fabric, and wet marble; cinematic golden-hour color grading with warm gold highlights and cool shadow contrast.

phase2.name: Transformation
phase2.prompt: As the cube’s vertical seam panels fold outward, a smooth mechanical transformation unfolds: petals open like a lotus, a stabilizer base with extensions locks into place. Three synchronized telescoping pedestals rise, assembling boxed deity forms with mechanical precision. Jagannath unit with deep-blue painted eyes, Balabhadra unit with oval eyes, and Subhadra unit with almond-shaped eyes emerge. Simultaneously, miniature raths with ornate wheel assemblies, decorative canopies, and draped garlands deploy. Mechanical seams, gears, and pistons articulate with realistic physics, soft pneumatic hisses, and micro-sparks. Halo of light crowns each deity-box as oil lamps ignite in sequence. The Jagannath Temple’s facade softly out of focus, warm golden-hour lighting aligns perfectly with the tableau. Camera performs a slow push-in reveal from macro foreground to complete miniature Rath tableau. Vertical alignment with golden sunlight through clouds adds divinity.

phase3.name: Resolution
phase3.prompt: The cinematic push-in completes, revealing the intricate Rath tableau in full glory. Each deity-box pulses with subtle power, halo lights gleam softly above. Flower petals and a ring of small oil lamps create an ethereal boundary around the scene. Highlighted Jagannath Temple’s spire and facade in serene golden-hour backdrop ensure focus returns to the divine miniature spectacle. Ultra-detailed textures and lighting accentuate every detail, providing photorealistic finishing touches.

ambient.name: Ambient
ambient.prompt: Gentle ambient sounds of a serene evening, subtle temple bells ringing, and the soft hum of mechanical precision from opening panels.

transformation.name: Transformation
transformation.prompt: Intricate mechanical whirs, slides, and locks; occasional gentle pneumatic releases and soft spark effects accompany the transformation in a syncopated sequence.

music.name: Music Score
music.prompt: A soothing instrumental with traditional Indian motifs incorporated into a modern orchestral arrangement, creating a harmonious balance with the visual tableau.

youtube.description: Experience the exquisitely detailed transformation of the Miniature Rath Yatra, where divine deities emerge in an orchestrated display of mechanical grace and Indian tradition. Capturing the essence of golden-hour magic and spiritual artistry.
